title: v0.40.14
excerpt: What's Changed ollama launch claude now applies the model's output token limit for Claude Code, so cloud models no longer run into the 128k default cap Cloud web search responses on /api/chat are now decoded correctly, including compressed responses OpenAI-compatible endpoints no longer override a model's packaged sampler defaults — clients that send no temperature / top_p get the model's own values instead of 1.0, matching /api/chat /v1/responses now preserves readable input content, including prior assistant refusals, instead of flattening it Ollama's app can now retry ChatGPT disconnect failures instead of leaving the connection in a broken state ollama launch codex verifies ChatGPT routing before configuring, and reports a clear error when routing is unavailable Faster top-k sampling on MLX for large vocabularies Full Changelog : v0.40.13...v0.40.14
